svg.title: Follow the next link until the report ends
svg.desc: A report may return its rows in several pages. A page with no rows can still have a link to the next page. Read. Collect the rows on the current page, even if the list is empty. Continue. If a next link exists and is new, follow it. Stop. A missing link ends the report. A link you already visited signals a loop.
svg.text: Follow the next link until the report ends
A report may return its rows in several pages. A page with no rows can still
have a link to the next page.
Collect the rows on the current page, even if the list is empty.
If a next link exists and is new, follow it.
A missing link ends the report. A link you already visited signals a loop.
